about.title: ABOUT
about.a_2: Become the World's Leading Hybrid Off-Road Brand
about.a_4: JETOUR was born with global vision. Launched in January, 2018, JETOUR is an emerging Chinese automotive brand in response to market trends and consumer demands.
about.a_5: With innovative products, unmatched performance, and user-oriented approach, JETOUR is quickly reshaping global automotive landscape.
about.a_7: JETOUR brand has continuously evolved, progressing through Stage 1.0 represented by travel SUV like X70, X90, and DASHING;Stage 2.0 marked by comfortable off-road vehicles such as T1 and T2. Now, it is fully entering Satge 3.0, represented by professional off-road vehicles like G700, G900, and F700, positioning itself within the international luxury off-road segment.
about.a_9: In 2019, JETOUR embarked on overseas operations while accelerating its global strategic layout. Currently, JETOUR's export products include compleete vehicles, complete knocked down (CKD) kits, and spare parts, covering 67 countries and regions across the Middle East, Africa, Central and South America, Asia-Pacific and CIS. JETOUR has established over 2,000 sales and service outets worldwide.
about.a_11: By 2030, JETOUR plans to establish 19 KD factories worldwide, expand its operations to over 91 markets, and achieve annual overseas salesof 1.1 million units. JETOUR also aims to develop over 1,600 distributions and generate revenue exceeding 100 billion RMB. This will comprehensively enhance the brand's capabilities in global operations, local value chain developmnent, and ecosystem management.
about.a_13: Guided by 'Travel<sup class="plus-sup1">+</sup>' strategy, JETOUR makes cars from the perspective of users, with thinking of travel industry and capabilities of auto industry.
about.a_14: We extend our product development philosophy to the entire ecology chain in travel scenarios, aiming to be the auto brand with the deepest understandings of travel.

daringToPioneer.title: Daring to Pioneer: JETOUR to Become First Automotive Brand to Traverse the Pan-American Highway
daringToPioneer.description: JETOUR has announced an upcoming long-distance journey spanning nine countries across North and South America, which will serve as a comprehensive test of its product capabilities and technological prowess under the Travel<sup class="plus-sup1">+</sup>” strategy.
daringToPioneer.text_1_1: JETOUR has announced an upcoming long-distance journey spanning nine countries across North and South America, which will serve as a comprehensive test of its product capabilities and technological prowess under the “Travel<sup class="plus-sup1">+</sup>” strategy.
daringToPioneer.text_2_1: Conquering Extreme Terrains, Validating All-Round Performance
daringToPioneer.text_2_2: The Pan-American Highway, approximately 48,000 kilometers in length, spans the Americas from north to south, passing through deserts, rainforests, plateaus, snowfields, and coastlines, making it one of the longest and most geographically diverse highways in the world.
daringToPioneer.text_3_1: JETOUR's “Traverse Pan-American Highway Project” will soon depart from Mexico, journeying through Panama, Ecuador, Colombia, Peru, Chile, Uruguay, and Paraguay before culminating in Ushuaia, Argentina.
daringToPioneer.text_4_1: The JETOUR T1 will undergo rigorous testing in diverse environments, including extreme heat, high altitudes, humidity, and rugged terrain. This expedition will push the vehicle’s performance to its limits while showcasing the practical application of JETOUR’s “Travel<sup class="plus-sup1">+</sup>” strategy.
daringToPioneer.text_5_1: T1: Where Urban Inspiration Meets Off-Road Capability
daringToPioneer.text_5_2: The star of this journey—the JETOUR T1—has been launched in global markets since 2025. As the flagship model of JETOUR's T series, it is positioned as an Urban Lite Off-road SUV.
daringToPioneer.text_6_1: Built on the Kunlun Off-road Platform and equipped with the Intelligent XWD system, this model effortlessly handles everything from city streets to challenging terrain such as sand, snow, and mountain paths. Its tech and quiet cockpit, with the intuitive Tour OS 2.0 system, offers drivers an immersive driving experience. Currently, the T1 has been launched in the Middle East, Africa, Central and South America, and the CIS region. With its striking design and intelligent experience, it has won the affection of users worldwide.
daringToPioneer.text_7_1: Travel<sup class="plus-sup1">+</sup> Strategy: Returning to Exploration and Connection
daringToPioneer.text_7_2: JETOUR remains steadfast in its “Travel<sup class="plus-sup1">+</sup>” strategy, committed to becoming the automotive brand that understands travel the most. Guided by this vision and long-term insights into real-world travel scenarios, the brand has successfully built a product portfolio tailored to diverse global travel lifestyles—including the X Series for family journeys and the T Series for off-road adventures.
daringToPioneer.text_7_3: The upcoming launch of the premium off-road G Series in November will further complete this lineup. It is this deep-rooted brand DNA and continuously expanding product foundation that have driven JETOUR to become the first automotive brand in the industry to take on the challenge of traversing the Pan-American Highway.
daringToPioneer.text_8_2: Today, JETOUR operates in 91 countries with over 2,000 sales and service outlets. The brand has gained a strong foothold in regions such as the Middle East, Africa, Central and South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. It has also successfully expanded into right-hand drive markets like South Africa, Indonesia, and Malaysia, and has officially entered the European Union market in 2025.
daringToPioneer.text_9_1: JETOUR believes that traversing the Pan-American Highway is not just a journey, but a conversation with the spirit of travel. By tackling diverse, complex terrains, engaging with local cultures and landscapes, and sharing authentic experiences, JETOUR aims to convey the core spirit of its 'Travel<sup class="plus-sup1">+</sup> Strategy,' which is to explore the unknown, discover new horizons, and connect the world to global users. We look forward to the T1’s delivering even more outstanding performance across the challenging and diverse terrains of the Pan-American Highway.

agree.section2Title: 2. What third-party services do we use?
agree.section2Intro: On our websites, we incorporate social plugins from popular social networks like Instagram, Facebook, X, and YouTube. Here's how they work:
agree.section2P1: When you visit our websites, social media plugins are initially deactivated. This means no information is transmitted to the network operators. If you want to use any of these networks, simply click on the respective plugin to establish a direct connection to their servers.
agree.section2P2: If you're logged into your user account on a social network when you activate the plugin, the network can recognize your visit to our websites and associate it with your account. To prevent this, please log out of the network before activating the social plugin. The social network cannot detect your visits to other websites of ours unless you activate its social plugin on those sites too.
agree.section2P3: When you activate a social plugin, the network directly transfers the available content to your browser, which integrates it into our websites. During this process, data transfers controlled by the respective social network may occur. Your connection to a social network, the data transfers between the network and your system, and your interactions on the platform are governed solely by the network's data protection provisions.
agree.section2P4: The social plugin remains active until you deactivate it or delete your cookies. For more information about cookies setting, please read our
agree.section2P5: Please note that our website may feature links to external websites beyond our control, and this Privacy Policy does not apply to them. If you access these websites through the provided links, the operators of those websites may collect information from you according to their own privacy policies, which may differ from ours.

agree.section3_2Title: 3.2 Services providers and business partners as data processors:

This includes compliance with law enforcement requirements, regulatory inquiries, and the verification or enforcement of our policies and procedures. We may also disclose information in emergency situations to prevent or halt potentially illegal, unethical, or legally actionable activities. When we receive a request for personal data from a law enforcement authority, we assess the necessity and proportionality of the requested information.
agree.section4Title: 4. How do we transfer your data outside your region?
agree.section4P1: JETOUR is a global company, and we operate internationally. By making a purchase or otherwise submitting your personal data to us, your information may be transferred to JETOUR in the countries other than your place of residence or in which the information was originally collected. For example, where we have facilities or in which we engage service providers. JETOUR complies with laws on the transfer of personal data between countries to help ensure your data is protected as described in this Statement, wherever it may be.
agree.section4P2: We may rely on various legal grounds to collect, use, and otherwise process your information, such as: your consent; that the information is necessary for the performance of a contract with you; to comply with a legal obligation; to protect your, or someone else's vital interests; or for a legitimate interest that is balanced against your rights and interests. These legitimate interests may include JETOUR's interest in improving its products and services, enhancing safety and security, protecting JETOUR or its business partners against wrongful conduct, and responding to customer inquiries and claims. Where applicable, we will inform you whether and why we need certain information from you, for example, whether we need the information to fulfill a legal or contractual requirement and what the consequences are of not providing the information.
agree.section4P3: If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), the United Kingdom (UK), or Switzerland, we ensure that the transfer of your personal data is carried out in accordance with applicable privacy laws and, in particular, that appropriate contractual, technical, and organizational measures are in place. JETOUR's international transfer of personal data collected in the EEA, the UK, and Switzerland is governed by Standard Contractual Clauses.

agree.section5_3Content: You may request from us the rectification of incorrect or incomplete personal data concerning you. We make reasonable efforts to keep personal data in our possession or control, which are used on an ongoing basis, accurate, complete, current and relevant, based on the most recent information available to us.
agree.section5_4Intro: You may request from us the restriction of processing of your personal data, if:
agree.section5_4P1: You contest the accuracy of your personal data, for the period we need to verify the accuracy;
agree.section5_4P2: The processing is unlawful and you request the restriction of processing rather than erasure of your personal data;
agree.section5_4P3: We no longer need your personal data for the processing purpose, but you require them for the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims; or
agree.section5_4P4: You object to the processing while we verify whether our legitimate grounds override yours.
agree.section5_5Content: You have the right to receive your personal data provided to us and, where technically feasible, request its transfer to another organization. This right applies if we process your personal data through automated means, based on your consent or for the performance of a contract you are a party to. Your personal data must have been provided by you, and this right should not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others. You can receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable format. The transmission of your personal data to another organization is subject to technical feasibility.
agree.section5_6Intro: You have the right to request that we delete the personal data we process about you. We must comply with this request unless the processing of your personal data is necessary for:
agree.section5_6P1: Compliance with a legal obligation requiring processing by laws to which we are subject;
agree.section5_6P2: Archiving purposes in the public interest, scientific or historical research purposes, or statistical purposes;
agree.section5_6P3: The establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims.
agree.section5_7Content: You have the right to object, at any time, to the processing of your personal data based on our legitimate interests or the legitimate interests of a third party, provided that the processing is not based on your consent. If you exercise this right, we will no longer process your personal data unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds that override your interests, rights, and freedoms, or if the processing is necessary for legal claims. If you object to the processing, please let us know if you also wish for your personal data to be erased.
agree.section5_8Content: You have the right to be informed about the collection and use of your personal data. We have prepared this Statement for this purpose, and you will be informed of any changes to this Statement.
agree.section5_9Content: You have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority or with any other data protection authority in your region. However, we would appreciate it if you first contact us to try to solve your issue – you can find our contact details in Section 8.
agree.section6Title: 6. How long do we retain your data?
agree.section6P1: We retain data related to our provided services in accordance with legal obligations. If you are a customer, we will keep your data for the duration of any contractual relationship you have with us, and, where permitted, beyond the end of that relationship for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes set out in this Privacy Statement.
agree.section6P2: We retain the data we collect from or about you for the period necessary to fulfil the purposes outlined in this Privacy Statement, unless a longer retention period is required or permitted by law. Once the data is no longer necessary for these purposes, we either delete it or retain it in an anonymized form. In determining the appropriate retention period, we take into account various criteria, including the type of services requested by or provided to you, the nature of our relationship with you, the potential impact on the services we provide to you if we delete certain data about you, and the retention periods mandated by law.
agree.section7Title: 7. How do we protect your data?
agree.section7P1: We strive to maintain high security standards and have implemented robust technical and organizational measures to protect your data, in accordance with the current, general state of technology. We ensure that your personal data is adequately secured against loss, falsification or unauthorized access. However, please note that the transmission of information via the internet is not completely secure. While we do our best to protect your personal data, we cannot guarantee 100% security of your data transmitted to us.
agree.section7P2: Once we have received your personal data, we use strict procedures and security features to prevent unauthorized access. In the unfortunate event of a personal data incident, we will report it and take remedial measures in accordance with the requirements of the law and regulatory authorities. We take the security and privacy of your data seriously. To ensure the highest standards of data protection, all personal data collected through our services is stored in a secure data storage centre located in Hong Kong, China. The data center is operated by Alibaba Cloud International Limited, located in 26/F, Tower One, Times Square, 1 Matheson Street, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
agree.section8Content1: We do not knowingly collect or use any personal data from children (we define "children" as those under 16 years of age) without prior, verifiable consent from the holder of parental responsibility for the child. We do not knowingly allow children to order our vehicles, contact us, or use any of our online services.
agree.section8Content2_1: If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us:
agree.section8Content2_2: . We will take all reasonable steps to delete the information as soon as possible and will not use such information for any purpose, except when necessary to protect the safety of the child or others as required by law.
agree.section9Title: 9. How can you contact us and make a request？
agree.section9P1: If you have any questions about the processing of your personal data, we recommend reading through this Privacy Statement first.
agree.section9P2: To make a query, raise a concern, or exercise your data subject rights, please feel free to contact us via:
agree.section9P4: We take your privacy seriously and aim to respond to you within one month or within the timeline specified by the relevant local privacy protection law, after confirming your identity. If you believe that we have not adequately addressed your complaints or concerns, you have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection authority.
agree.section10Title: 10. How will we update this Privacy Statement?
agree.section10Content: We may update this Privacy Statement, for example, to reflect changes in our business operations and measures for protecting personal information. If we make changes to this Privacy Statement, we will notify you. Where changes to this Privacy Statement significantly impact the nature of our data processing or have a substantial effect on you, we will provide sufficient advance notice, allowing you the opportunity to exercise any applicable rights.

subject.articleSubtitle1:
With a hardcore, edgy exterior and a plush, high-tech cabin,
the JETOUR T2 is making waves in the SUV game
subject.articleSubtitleMobile1:
With a hardcore, edgy exterior
and a plush, high-tech cabin,
the JETOUR T2 is making waves
in the SUV game
subject.articleParagraph1: A number of years ago, much of the Middle East had somewhat of an awkward relationship with off-road driving. The desire was there, certainly. The vast expanses of rugged terrain were there, too. The problem was that these glorious spots were often just largely unreachable by car — way offroad, for want of a better phrase. Thankfully, the gap has been bridged somewhat in recent years, with better access routes to mountainous beauty achieved, meaning that off-road adventure is now just a short drive away. Custom built for the arrival of the JETOUR T2, you might say.
subject.articleParagraph2: First things first: regardless of where you go to find excitement, we're firm believers that you should look good in the process. With sharp lines and a rugged, angular cool, the design language of the JETOUR T2 is described as "hardcore". And we get that. But there's a soft, retro charm there as well. A real personality. In a busy market, the T2 has the style chops to stand out.
subject.articleParagraph3: Derived from the words 'jet' and 'tour' (meaning 'convenient' and 'travel' in Mandarin), JETOUR is more than just a snappy title — it's a mission statement. So, while the exterior is rugged and bold, the interior adds a touch of luxury to the toughness. Here, an almost industrial feel is undeniable, with exposed bolts and rivets as well as a minimalist layout. But the futuristic driver's cockpit, the 64-inch panoramic sunroof, and plush suede seating collective prove that style and substance go together.
subject.articleParagraph4: Your cabin is filled with other smarts, too. There's intelligent voice control, the use of environmentally friendly materials, premium soundproofing,and Sony audio configuration for when you want the sound inside to be on another level. Add the oversized central control screen – perfect for both operating the car and watching movies – and we fully understand should you wish to not only drive the T2, but possibly live in it as well. There's certainly room.
subject.articleParagraph5: Of course, good looks and neat features are all well and good, but this is a beefy new SUV with big market competition, so we need performance, too. When driving in the city, the T2 offers a suitably comfortable, safe, and responsive drive. That might seem like a throwaway line, but it's not. Regardless of your off-roading ambitions, it's likely that the majority of your driving will come in an urban environment, so the fact that the T2 has you covered here is important.
subject.articleParagraph6: But, of course, it's when you take the T2 off the beaten track that the fun really starts, and thanks to the XWD technology and multiple driving modes, it can tackle any number of landscapes. The most exciting element? The XWD (X Wheel Drive) technology. Exclusive to the market, this fully intelligent drive system will switch instantly from 4WD to 2WD, depending on the situation you find yourself in. No need to stop and switch when you need a little more power — the oomph comes as a standard.
subject.articleParagraph7: In a busy and powerful SUV market, the JETOUR T2 is not simply here to make up the numbers. Competitively priced and ruggedly charming, it has a drive experience that could really make a name for itself in the region and beyond. With greater access to the Middle East's natural beauty ever increasing, it looks like your off-road adventures just got a whole lot better looking.(Published in GQ Middle East April 2024 issue)

topic.articleSubtitle1: WORDS BY EMILE ZARIFE • PHOTOGRAPHY BY ŽIGA MIHELČIČ
topic.articleSubtitleMobile1:
WORDS BY EMILE ZARIFE • PHOTOGRAPHY BY ŽIGA
MIHELČIČ
topic.articleParagraph1: Known for putting creativity and authenticity at the heart of his work, Harith Bukhash continues to drive the social industry forward, something the JETOUR G700 understands all too well.
topic.articleParagraph2: The JETOUR G700 is a trailblazer, a premium hybrid SUV that embodies strength, sophistication, and fearless innovation.
topic.articleParagraph3: As co-founder of Bukhash Brothers, Harith Bukhash has been a pivotal part in reshaping how brands communicate across the Arab world. Alongside his brother, Anas, he launched one of Dubai’s first licensed influencer marketing agencies, long before influencer culture became a global phenomenon. “We’ve always been passionate about creativity,” Harith explains. “And with Anas’ strong relationships with major brands, we saw an opportunity. In 2014, we decided to take the risk and launch Dubai’s first digital agency.”
topic.articleParagraph4: Today, their Golden Stevie® award-winning digital marketing firm plays an influential role in how brands speak, look, and connect across the Arab world. “We want to craft stories that resonate. For us, it’s always been about nurturing the relationships we build with our clients. Just like our slogan says, ‘we design meaningful relationships’ and that’s exactly what we strive to do every day.”
topic.articleParagraph5: Their success story is fundamentally tied to Dubai’s pulse, a city that thrives on reinvention. “We’re truly grateful to be part of Dubai, one of the world’s leading cities for creativity and innovation,” he says. “The energy here has played a big role in our growth, inspiring us to evolve across every segment of our work.”
topic.articleParagraph6: was intentional. “It wasn’t easy, but my brother was with me every step. We built it together.” For Harith, risk is thoughtful, never reckless: “Sometimes, it’s about embracing the unknown; other times, it’s about slowing down to reflect. The key is knowing when to do each.”
topic.articleParagraph7: That balance between ambition and reflection is something Harith navigates daily. It’s this duality and the drive to push forward that seamlessly ties his story to the JETOUR G700. Much like Harith, the JETOUR G700 is a trailblazer, a premium hybrid SUV that embodies strength, sophistication, and fearless innovation. Crafted for those who push boundaries, the SUV is built for those who live beyond the horizon, bridging performance with urban luxury.
topic.articleParagraph8: “To me, reinvention is about staying true to my values while exploring every step of the journey. It’s taking risks, remaining open, and never settling for the expected.”
topic.articleParagraph9: His advice to young Emirati entrepreneurs? “Try. There’s rarely much to lose. Consistency and belief in your vision are what matter most.”
topic.articleParagraph10: While success is often measured by milestones, Harith defines his differently: “Ultimate success means excelling in what I do while maintaining close, caring relationships with my loved ones. Above all, it’s about being there for them and taking care of what matters most.”

subject_bs.articleSubtitle1: YASMINE SIMA channels effortlessly COOL confidence while at the wheel of the JETOUR T1
subject_bs.articleSubtitleMobile1:
YASMINE SIMA channels effortlessly COOL
confidence while at the wheel of the JETOUR T1
subject_bs.articleParagraph1: YASMINE SIMA understands life in the FAST LANE – both literally and figuratively...
subject_bs.articleParagraph2: Born and raised in motor-loving Los Angeles before relocating to supercar-studded Dubai two years ago, the model and content creator now speaks to an audience of more than 300,000 on Instagram alone. For someone whose career thrives on staying ahead of the cultural curve, Dubai – first intended as a short visit – quickly became the city where her ambitions could shift effortlessly into high gear.
subject_bs.articleParagraph3: Scouted as a teenager after being discovered in a Texas mall by Ford Models at just 15 and signing at 19, Yasmine seems almost preordained for the spotlight. She describes her platform as an “amazing opportunity to keep expressing myself in different ways,” a sentiment that crystallised as her following grew through her early fashion diaries and behind-the-scenes glimpses of model life.
subject_bs.articleParagraph4: With that trust comes responsibility. Sima – whose evolving aesthetic has taken a “rockstar chic” direction at the moment – chooses collaborations with a discerning eye. “I’ve been very blessed to do some amazing global campaigns like Valentino and Dior, and to work on editorials that highlight the culture of this region,” she says.
subject_bs.articleParagraph5: What does she look for in a partnership? “The most important aspect for me is whether I can channel the character the brand represents.” Speaking from the driver’s seat of the JETOUR T1 on set, she continues, “With JETOUR, it aligned perfectly. It represents boldness, confidence – it’s sleek and cool. I really enjoyed channelling that energy.”
subject_bs.articleParagraph6: The JETOUR T1’s fashion-forward design clearly spoke to her sensibilities: rugged yet refined, with a silhouette that feels at home both in the desert and in the city. With six exterior colourways, three interior configurations, distinctive four-leaf-clover headlights and petal-style alloy wheels, the SUV offers plenty of space for personal expression – a feature not lost on a tastemaker who understands the power of aesthetics.
subject_bs.articleParagraph7: Yet Yasmine’s path has been anything but straightforward. Before embracing a full-time creative career, she briefly pursued a law degree, unsure of where her ambitions would land. It was a stay with her aunt in the UAE that secured her path. “I loved it,” she recalls. The city felt like the land of opportunities. Today, she counts working with designers she followed since childhood, travelling with brands, and attending shows in Paris and Milan among her pinch-me moments. Still, she remains candid about the pressures: “The hardest aspect? The constant need to create. Sometimes I do feel burnout.”
subject_bs.articleParagraph8: A California girl at heart, road trips remain part of her DNA. Her dream drive? “I love this question!” she beams. “I would go with my mum – one of the strongest women I know and my ultimate best friend – and my cat. Iceland would be ideal. And, maybe I’d take a JETOUR T1! I’d love to be make-up free, carry just the essentials, and enjoy the dramatic scenery.” With its 2.0L turbocharged engine and off-road prowess, the T1 feels tailor-made for Iceland’s black-sand beaches and waterfall-lined cliffs.
subject_bs.articleParagraph9: Its intelligent off-road system – with seven driving modes spanning Snow, Sand, Sport, Eco, Mud, Rock, and Highway – makes the SUV equally adaptable to the Middle East’s varied terrain. And for the quieter moments?
subject_bs.articleParagraph10: The cabin’s city-centric comfort design shines: a high-tech cockpit anchored by a 15.6-inch infotainment display with Apple AirPlay, 360-degree cameras, a wireless charging pad, and ventilated seats. “Anywhere with a great spa is a must for me,” she says of her UAE staycations. “My life is very busy, so in my downtime, I like to relax and do absolutely nothing.” With dual-layer soundproof glass and 79 sound-dampening materials, the T1 ensures her serenity begins long before she reaches the spa.
subject_bs.articleParagraph11: For fashion devotees, Yasmine shares another exclusive: a major silver-screen debut. “My most exciting moment this year will be appearing in The Devil Wears Prada 2 movie at the Dolce&Gabbana show!” she reveals. Clearly, she is not just in the zeitgeist – she is shaping it.
subject_bs.articleParagraph12: “Success, to me, means being at peace with yourself while having the freedom to be creative and continue learning with an open mind,” she reflects. And as she moves into her next chapter, it’s evident that Yasmine Sima’s drive – much like the JETOUR T1 she commands – has only shifted into a more powerful gear.
